trees.name: Affliction
trees.nameSource: TalentTab order, confirmed by Era talent names

nodes.name: Improved Life Tap
nodes.description: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 10%.

ranks.1: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 10%.

nodes.name: Suppression
nodes.description: Improves your chance to hit by 1% and reduces all threat you generate by 4%.

ranks.1: Improves your chance to hit by 1% and reduces all threat you generate by 4%.

nodes.name: Improved Corruption
nodes.description: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 0.4 sec and increases the damage it deals by 2%.

ranks.1: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 0.4 sec and increases the damage it deals by 2%.

nodes.name: Malediction
nodes.description: Increases all periodic damage done by your Warlock spells by 1%.

ranks.1: Increases all periodic damage done by your Warlock spells by 1%.

nodes.name: Soul Harvesting
nodes.description: You gain Soul Harvest for 10 sec if a victim is killed while afflicted with your Drain Soul. Soul Harvest allows your Mana to regenerate at 50% of normal speed while you are casting spells, and grants a 50% increase to your Mana regeneration.

ranks.1: You gain Soul Harvest for 10 sec if a victim is killed while afflicted with your Drain Soul. Soul Harvest allows your Mana to regenerate at 50% of normal speed while you are casting spells, and grants a 50% increase to your Mana regeneration.

nodes.name: Improved Drains
nodes.description: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 7%.

ranks.1: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 7%.

nodes.name: Improved Bane of Agony
nodes.description: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 5%.

ranks.1: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 5%.

nodes.name: Fel Concentration
nodes.description: Gives you a 23% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.

ranks.1: Gives you a 23% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.

nodes.name: Amplify Curse
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

ranks.1: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

nodes.name: Pandemic
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 33%.

ranks.1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 33%.

nodes.name: Malevolence
nodes.description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 1%.

ranks.1: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 1%.

nodes.name: Nightfall
nodes.description: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 2% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

ranks.1: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 2% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

nodes.name: Curse of Exhaustion
nodes.description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

ranks.1: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

nodes.name: Siphon Life
nodes.description: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

ranks.1: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

nodes.name: Soul Siphon
nodes.description: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 4% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%.

ranks.1: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 4% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%.

nodes.name: Shadow Mastery
nodes.description: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 1%.

ranks.1: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 1%.

nodes.name: Wrack
nodes.description: Tears the target apart from within, dealing 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10%. Lasts 6 sec.

ranks.1: Tears the target apart from within, dealing 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10%. Lasts 6 sec.

trees.name: Demonology
trees.nameSource: TalentTab order, confirmed by Era talent names

nodes.name: Improved Health Funnel
nodes.description: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 20%, reduces its health cost by 15%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 50%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

ranks.1: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 20%, reduces its health cost by 15%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 50%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

nodes.name: Improved Imp
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 10% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 10%.

ranks.1: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 10% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 10%.

nodes.name: Demonic Embrace
nodes.description: Increases your total Stamina by 3%.

ranks.1: Increases your total Stamina by 3%.

nodes.name: Unholy Power
nodes.description: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 2%.

ranks.1: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 2%.

nodes.name: Demonic Aegis
nodes.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 15%.

ranks.1: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 15%.

nodes.name: Improved Voidwalker
nodes.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 10%.

ranks.1: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 10%.

nodes.name: Fel Vitality
nodes.description: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 5%, and increases your maximum Mana by 5%.

ranks.1: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 5%, and increases your maximum Mana by 5%.

nodes.name: Demonic Energies
nodes.description: You heal your pet for 8% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 50% of the Mana you gain.

ranks.1: You heal your pet for 8% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 50% of the Mana you gain.

nodes.name: Improved Sayaad
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 10%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 10%.

ranks.1: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 10%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 10%.

nodes.name: Demonic Sacrifice
nodes.description:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 120 min. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

ranks.1:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 120 min. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

nodes.name: Master Summoner
nodes.description: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 2 sec and the Mana cost by 20%.

ranks.1: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 2 sec and the Mana cost by 20%.

nodes.name: Decimation
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 45%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 3% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 20% and costs no Soul Shards.

ranks.1: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 45%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 3% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 20% and costs no Soul Shards.

nodes.name: Fel Domination
nodes.description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

ranks.1: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

nodes.name: Demonic Brand
nodes.description: Your Searing Pain generates 17% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 2 attacks against the target generate high threat and deal to Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet.

ranks.1: Your Searing Pain generates 17% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 2 attacks against the target generate high threat and deal to Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet.

nodes.name: Improved Felhunter
nodes.description: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 10%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 2 sec.

ranks.1: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 10%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 2 sec.

nodes.name: Soul Link
nodes.description: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

ranks.1: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

nodes.name: Demonic Knowledge
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 33% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

ranks.1: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 33% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

nodes.name: Master Demonologist
nodes.description:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 2%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 2%.

Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 2%.

Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 2%.

ranks.1:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 2%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 2%.

Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 2%.

Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 2%.

nodes.name: Demonic Pact
nodes.description: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

ranks.1: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

trees.name: Destruction
trees.nameSource: TalentTab order, confirmed by Era talent names

nodes.name: Destructive Reach
nodes.description: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 10%.

ranks.1: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 10%.

nodes.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
nodes.description: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 4% for 12 sec.

ranks.1: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 4% for 12 sec.

nodes.name: Bane
nodes.description: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.1 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 0.4 sec.

ranks.1: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.1 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 0.4 sec.

nodes.name: Molten Skin
nodes.description: Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

ranks.1: Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

nodes.name: Cataclysm
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 3%.

ranks.1: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 3%.

nodes.name: Aftermath
nodes.description: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 10% and your Conflagrate spell has a 20% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

ranks.1: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 10% and your Conflagrate spell has a 20% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

nodes.name: Ruin
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 20%.

ranks.1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 20%.

nodes.name: Shadowburn
nodes.description: Instantly blasts the target for 66 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

ranks.1: Instantly blasts the target for 66 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

nodes.name: Intensity
nodes.description: Gives you a 23% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.

ranks.1: Gives you a 23% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.

nodes.name: Agonizing Flames
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 3% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 3%.

ranks.1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 3% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 3%.

nodes.name: Conflagrate
nodes.description: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 95 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

ranks.1: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 95 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

nodes.name: Pyroclasm
nodes.description: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 13% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 13% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

ranks.1: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 13% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 13% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

nodes.name: Bane of Havoc
nodes.description: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

ranks.1: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

nodes.name: Fire and Brimstone
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 8%.

ranks.1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 8%.

nodes.name: Shadow and Flame
nodes.description: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 2% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 20% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 20% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

ranks.1: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 2% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 20% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 20% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

nodes.name: Incinerate
nodes.description: Deals 97 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

ranks.1: Deals 97 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

copy.notice: Select a talent to read its beta tooltip, then add a point.
copy.unknownRank: The beta client stores one tooltip per talent, shown at rank 1. It does not list this rank's values separately.
copy.prereqNote: Arrow from the client's TraitEdge table.
copy.available: Available: the row's point gate and any arrow into it are met.
copy.noPrereq: No arrow leads into this talent.
copy.rulesNote: The planner starts at 51 points. A row opens once the points the client lists for it are spent in earlier rows of the same tab (0 to 30). Lines between talents are the client's arrows; the talent at the start must be at full rank.
copy.help: Keyboard: Tab to a talent, Enter to inspect, + to add, - to remove. Right-click also removes a point.
